name: AI IT Support Automation Agent - Main

nodes.name: Webhook - Ticket Intake
nodes.notes: Primary webhook endpoint for ticket intake from Slack, Teams, Email, or API

nodes.name: Rate Limiter - Batch Control
nodes.notes: Controls concurrency - processes 5 tickets at a time to prevent API overload

nodes.name: Wait Between Batches
nodes.notes: 2-second delay between batches to respect rate limits

nodes.name: Store Raw Ticket (Audit)
nodes.notes: Stores immutable raw ticket for compliance and audit purposes

nodes.name: Validate JSON Schema
nodes.notes: Validates incoming ticket against required JSON schema

nodes.name: Validation Check
nodes.notes: Routes valid tickets to processing, invalid to error handling

nodes.name: PII/PHI Redaction
nodes.notes: Redacts PII/PHI (emails, SSN, phone, passwords, health info) before AI processing

nodes.name: Sensitive Category Bypass
nodes.notes: Bypasses AI for sensitive categories (Legal, Executive, Termination) - direct escalation

nodes.name: Direct Escalation (Sensitive)
nodes.notes: Sets flags for sensitive tickets that bypass AI processing

nodes.name: RAG - Knowledge Base Retrieval
nodes.notes: Retrieves relevant SOP/knowledge base context for AI classification

nodes.name: AI Classification (OpenAI)

parameters.jsonBody: ={"model": "gpt-4o", "temperature": 0.1, "max_tokens": 500, "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}, "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": "You are an IT Support Classification Agent. Analyze tickets and respond with JSON: {\"category\": \"string\", \"priority\": \"string\", \"urgency\": \"string\", \"suggested_resolution\": \"string\", \"confidence\": number}. Categories: Email/Authentication, Hardware/Performance, Hardware/Printer, Software/Installation, Network/VPN, Security, Access Request, Other. Priority/Urgency: critical, high, medium, low. Confidence: 0-1."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Classify: Title: {{ $json.title_sanitized }} Description: {{ $json.description_sanitized }}"}]}

nodes.notes: LLM classification with few-shot prompting via OpenAI API

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Parses AI JSON response and validates confidence score

nodes.name: Confidence Threshold Check
nodes.notes: Routes tickets based on confidence threshold (>= 0.8 = auto-process, < 0.8 = human review)

nodes.name: Human Review - Slack Notification
nodes.notes: Sends Slack notification for human review when confidence < 0.8

nodes.name: Wait for Human Decision
nodes.notes: Waits for human approval callback (timeout: 2 hours)

nodes.name: Merge Processing Paths
nodes.notes: Merges auto-approved and human-approved ticket paths

nodes.name: Shadow Mode Check
nodes.notes: Checks SHADOW_MODE env var - if true, logs only without ServiceNow actions

nodes.name: Shadow Mode - Log Only
nodes.notes: Logs AI decision without taking ServiceNow action (for 48-hour validation)

nodes.name: ServiceNow Create or Update
nodes.notes: Determines whether to create new ticket or update existing based on sys_id

nodes.name: ServiceNow - Create Incident
nodes.notes: Creates new incident in ServiceNow with AI classification data

nodes.name: ServiceNow - Update Incident
nodes.notes: Updates existing incident in ServiceNow using sys_id

nodes.name: Store sys_id Response
nodes.notes: Stores sys_id from ServiceNow response for future updates

nodes.name: Final Audit Log
nodes.notes: Creates final audit log entry for compliance and monitoring

nodes.name: Webhook Response
nodes.notes: Returns success response to webhook caller

nodes.name: Validation Error Handler
nodes.notes: Handles tickets that fail schema validation

nodes.name: Error Response
nodes.notes: Returns 400 error for invalid tickets
